personalizedPlans.question: Does Movive create personalized plans?
personalizedPlans.answer: Yes. Movive adapts your workouts, nutrition, and goals based on your experience level, availability, and fitness objectives to provide a personalized experience.

whatMakesDifferent.question: What makes Movive different from other fitness apps?
whatMakesDifferent.answer: Movive combines training, nutrition, progress tracking, and AI assistance in a single platform, eliminating the need to use multiple apps.

trainAtHome.question: Can I train at home or without equipment?
trainAtHome.answer: Yes. Movive includes programs designed for home workouts, gym training, and calisthenics, adapted to the equipment you have available.

customMeals.question: Can I modify meals or log custom foods?
customMeals.answer: Yes. You can use the recipes suggested by the platform or log your own meals to keep a more accurate record of your nutrition.

missPlan.question: What happens if I don't follow my plan 100%?
missPlan.answer: You don't need to be perfect to make progress. Movive is designed to help you stay consistent and make long-term improvements.

progressMeasured.question: How is my progress measured?
progressMeasured.answer: Movive tracks workouts, nutrition, goal completion, and fitness metrics to help you clearly visualize your progress over time.

switchPlans.question: Can I change or cancel my plan at any time?
switchPlans.answer: Yes. You can manage your subscription and make changes according to the options available for your account.

manageAccount.question: How do I manage my account and personal data?
manageAccount.answer: You can request a copy of your data, delete your account, or contact support through the help and settings sections available within the platform.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Movive, your health data is personal. This policy explains what we collect, why we collect it, and how we keep it protected while you track your workouts, nutrition and progress.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: We collect the account details you provide (name, email) and the fitness data you log: workouts, meals and recipes, weight and body measurements, progress photos, water and supplement intake, and meal plans. We also collect basic technical data such as device type and app usage needed to run the service.

sections.heading: How we use your data
sections.body: Your data is used to power the features you use — calculating calories and macros, showing your progress over time, generating meal plans and shopping lists, and personalizing recommendations. We never sell your personal or health data to third parties.

sections.heading: Data storage and security
sections.body: Your information is stored on secured infrastructure with encryption in transit. Access is protected by row-level security so you can only read and write your own records. Progress photos and other uploads are kept in a private storage bucket tied to your account.

sections.heading: Data sharing
sections.body: We share data only with the service providers required to operate Movive (for example, hosting and database services), and only to the extent needed. We may disclose information if required by law.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can access, export or delete your data at any time from your account settings. Deleting your account permanently removes your logged workouts, nutrition entries, measurements and photos.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: If you have questions about this policy or your data, reach out through the in-app feedback option and we'll respond as soon as possible.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Movive. By creating an account or using the app, you agree to them. Please read them carefully.

sections.heading: Using the service
sections.body: You must be at least 16 years old to use Movive. You are responsible for keeping your account credentials secure and for all activity that happens under your account.

sections.heading: Not medical advice
sections.body: Movive is a fitness and nutrition tracking tool, not a medical service. Calorie targets, macros, workouts and recommendations are for general informational purposes only and are not a substitute for professional medical, nutritional or training advice. Consult a qualified professional before starting any new diet or exercise program.

sections.heading: Your content
sections.body: You keep ownership of the data you create — your workouts, recipes, meal plans, measurements and photos. You grant us the limited permission needed to store and display that content back to you within the app.

sections.heading: Subscriptions
sections.body: Some features may require a paid plan. Pricing and billing terms are shown before you subscribe. You can manage or cancel your subscription from your account at any time.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
sections.body: Do not misuse the service, attempt to access other users' data, disrupt the platform, or upload unlawful or harmful content. We may suspend accounts that violate these terms.

sections.heading: Changes and termination
sections.body: We may update these terms or the service over time. Continued use after changes means you accept the updated terms. You may stop using Movive and delete your account at any time.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This policy explains how Movive uses cookies and similar technologies to keep you signed in and remember your preferences.

sections.heading: What are cookies
sections.body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device. We use them, along with similar local-storage technologies, to make the app work and to remember your choices.

sections.heading: Essential cookies
sections.body: These are required for the app to function — for example, keeping you securely signed in and maintaining your session. The app cannot work properly without them.

sections.heading: Preference cookies
sections.body: We remember settings such as your chosen language (English or Spanish) and interface preferences so the app looks the way you expect on your next visit.

sections.heading: Analytics
sections.body: We may use privacy-respecting, aggregated usage measurements to understand which features are used and improve the product. These do not identify you personally.

sections.heading: Managing cookies
sections.body: You can clear or block cookies through your browser settings. Note that disabling essential cookies will sign you out and prevent core features from working.
